description: Enumeration questions over a record that is deliberately partial. The answer must list what is recorded, say the record may be incomplete, never claim to be complete, and never invent the members it was not given (the names in must_not_include exist in the scenario but were never written to Beakr). Synthetic: sites, people and samples are invented.
